statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Nasdaq futures materially underperform S&P futures as semiconductor premarket losses, European technology weakness, oil near $108 and high yields align; granular NQ retracement structure remains unverified.
recommendation: Orange reflects several current amplifiers without direct confirmation of a persistent no-retracement NQ path. Deeper two-way rotations would weaken Tail evidence; failed or shallow retracements would strengthen it.
headline: Nasdaq premarket weakness deepens as chips, oil and rates align
body: Reuters shows Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.72% versus 0.70% for S&P futures, with Intel, AMD and Marvell down roughly 5-6% premarket. European technology is down 2%, Brent is near $108, and yields remain near 5%; direct granular NQ pullback evidence remains unavailable.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through most of Sunday, moved to WATCH at 22:00 UTC, and has stayed elevated since 23:00 UTC. The latest published 09:00 UTC assessment was Tail 31 with Stress 100 and Confidence 87.
outlookSummary: Tail remains elevated into the U.S. cash-open checkpoint if Nasdaq underperformance and chip weakness persist. It can move toward WATCH or low as meaningful retracements and two-way trade develop; later-week macro and FOMC checkpoints primarily sustain Stress before they occur.

forecast.analysis: Nasdaq 100 futures are down 1.72% versus 0.70% for S&P futures; Intel, AMD and Marvell are down about 5-6% premarket, European tech is down 2%, Brent is near $108 and yields remain near 5%. Granular NQ pullback structure is still unverified.
